route: scripted (procedural Blender geometry, rig and keyed clips; no provider generation)

skin.policy: rigid: one bone per vertex at weight 1.0

rootMotion: code-owned: the root joint is never animated and every clip plays in place

references.note: P5-T3 concept sheet (Higgsfield nano_banana_pro); concept approved by Paul 2026-11-16 (D8)

materialsUsed: approved P4-T3 brass-polished set bound by slot name at runtime, sampled at one texel (constant UV) and tinted by the manifest slot tint [0.87, 0.78, 0.62] (linear multiplier); golem-case (walnut, pleats from COLOR_0), golem-metal (gunmetal and emerald from COLOR_0) and golem-glow are factor-only
license: Original work generated in Blender from a checked-in script; concept reference from Paul's paid Higgsfield plan (Terms of Use 4.4)

authorSelfScore.scorer: author self-score (the authoring agent; not the independent score create-rigged-character-assets requires)
gaps: The pose stands upright with the arms hanging near vertical from the side and the fist under the shoulder; the sheet hunches the torso and angles the forearms forward with the fists ahead of the knees (needs a spine pitch in every clip and a longer forearm, with new head, chimney and pauldron clearance checks).

The fists are now closed brass masses with flat finger plates and a thumb plate, but the mass is squarer than the sheet's rounded mitt and the finger plates are shallow, so the fist reads as a plated box from the front.
The pauldrons are domed drums turning about the shoulder axis; the sheet's shoulder plates are tall curved plates hugging the barrel, which the attack raise rules out without clavicle animation.
The barrel keeps near-straight sides instead of the sheet's egg, the feet are layered blocks and the pelvis is a plain gunmetal bulge.

The upper-body brass is about 25% darker than the sheet's in the engine (median V 0.45 against 0.60) although the forearm now matches (V 0.50); the barrel walnut is about 20% lighter and the pleats greyer (hue 33 against 14) because the environment specular dominates their vertex colour.
Surface detail is flat: the brass is one texel of the shared set (no grain, wear or engraving), the walnut is factor-only with no plank grain or horizontal plank joints as painted on the sheet.
Through the death fall the thigh plates pass under the belt band while the body folds (28 to 32 crossing triangles per side, against 22 to 24 for the pass-2 plates).
In the EEVEE compare renders the grilles read pale because the D11 glow ramp is runtime-only; the engine shots show the intended amber core.
authorSelfScore.method: Author self-score from bellows-golem.fidelity-compare.jpg: orthographic EEVEE renders (AgX, the fixed shared light rig, not tuned to the score) of the low-poly model at the concept sheet's front, side and back angles, framed at the sheet's own scale (2.1 m over 806 sheet pixels), judged side by side against the sheet crops, plus the six in-engine shots in staging/engine (three.js 0.186.1, headless Chromium on ANGLE Metal, Apple M4, with the runtime D11 glow look; glow-close is the seat camera narrowed to the upper body). This pass followed the independent review (73/100) and its top fixes: each fist is now one closed brass mass 0.54 m wide (2.4 cm wider than the gauntlet) carrying two rows of flat bevelled finger plates (knuckles tilted 35 degrees up, middle phalanges facing front, 1.2 cm proud with brass-floored creases, no gunmetal core) and a heavy chamfered thumb plate folded across the index and middle plates, seated on the mass; every brass face samples one AO-255 texel of the shared brass-polished set (FLAT_BRASS) with a manifest tint of (0.87, 0.78, 0.62), so the AO grain that read as olive wood or pale teeth on the knuckles and the swirl on the head face plate are gone (fine-scale luminance residual in glow-close: head plate 5.8 to 4.9, pauldron 4.3 to 3.2; idle fist tops 10.7 to 6.4 and 9.3 to 5.7); bulkier legs (thigh 0.15, an uncrowned brass thigh plate to 0.19 that narrows to 0.172 at its top, clear of the belt in frozen and on the attack slam, greave 0.195) and a front-facing emerald in a brass bezel on each knee cap, so the front view now shows the two knee emeralds besides the side-facing pauldron and elbow ones. Engine colour medians (idle shot, brass/walnut masks): forearm brass (128, 95, 57) and (130, 96, 55), hue 32 to 33, S 0.55 to 0.58, V 0.50 to 0.51 (concept forearm 127, 88, 48, hue 30, S 0.62, V 0.50); fists (107, 77, 39) V 0.42 and (114, 85, 46) V 0.45, the same material and texel, darker only from their downward and crease-shaded faces; upper-body brass (116, 86, 48), V 0.45 (concept 154, 111, 57, V 0.60); barrel walnut (83, 55, 35), V 0.33 (concept 68, 42, 27); bellows pleats (52, 41, 28), V 0.20 (concept 44, 28, 23, V 0.17); front grille glow (245, 192, 81); eyes (243, 178, 71); glow-close grille (246, 193, 78). Vent: the chimney flame plume on the sheet is not modeled. p5-automatons-design.md models the vent as an emissive chimney mouth only and the art bible rules out smoke, so each mouth carries a glowing ember dome instead; this is a design-note deviation, not a fidelity gap.

independentScore.scorer: independent reviewer agent (separate from the authoring agent; did not build the model)

rubric.note: The head is the one large shape that moved: the capsule now stands clearly proud of the collar between the chimneys in the front compare panel and in every engine shot, as the sheet draws it, and the bellows now narrow below the barrel. The rest of the big shapes are unchanged. The pauldrons still read from the front and back as side-on stacked drums with a dome cap, where the sheet has tall curved plates that hug the barrel and cap the shoulder. The barrel keeps near-straight sides instead of the sheet's egg. The side view stands upright with the arms hanging vertical and the fist under the shoulder, where the sheet hunches and angles the forearm forward with the fist ahead of the knee. The legs are slim cylinders with black thighs against the sheet's bulky brass leg armour, the feet are blocks, and the fists are now an open, cupped hand of separate finger blocks with a hooked thumb, narrower than the gauntlet, where the sheet's fist is a compact round mass wider than the gauntlet.

Three signature items now match. The front grille has six glowing slots between five thin bars, measured as six glow runs along the centre line of glow-close against six on the sheet, with a hot centre (hue 49 to 51 in the middle slots, 34 to 36 at the edges; the sheet runs 52 in the centre to 21 at the edges). The head carries a faceted face plate with the two round amber eyes, measured (243, 173, 70) against the sheet's (238, 175, 74). The back strap now arches across the upper back in the back compare panel, shallower than the sheet's. The chimney ember domes stand in for the flame plume as the design note asks. Still short: the fists have a knuckle row but read as separate pegs over a gunmetal core with a thin tube thumb, not the sheet's closed fist with a heavy thumb plate; and emeralds show only on the pauldron hubs and elbows from the side, with none on the knees or upper arms from the front, where the sheet shows six from the front.

The pleats are dark rounded tubes and the riveted waist band, lugs and knee caps still add credible detail. New problem: the brass tileable reads as wood on flat faces. The knuckle blocks in idle measure (73, 52, 21), V 0.29, against the forearm brass at V 0.57 in the same shot, so they read as olive wooden dowel ends, and in the attack shot the same faces and the gauntlet end cap turn pale cream with a visible grain, like teeth. The grille bars and ring in glow-close show the same pale grain. The circular brass swirl is still visible on the head face plate in glow-close, so the lower normal strength did not remove it. The face plate is barely raised and the eyes are visibly faceted octagons. The walnut is a flat colour with a few vertical seams and none of the sheet's plank grain or horizontal plank joints, and the pelvis, thighs and feet are plain.

Judged from the engine shots. The pleats now match the sheet's value: idle (49, 39, 30), V 0.19, against the concept's (56, 38, 30), V 0.22, though greyer (hue 28, S 0.39 against hue 18, S 0.46), so the dark-bellows-under-lit-barrel split now reads. The barrel walnut measures (73, 46, 31), V 0.29, in idle and V 0.37 in glow-close, against the concept's shaded panels at V 0.23 to 0.25, the same hue (21). Brass varies by region rather than being uniformly darker: the idle forearm is (146, 115, 71), hue 35, S 0.51, V 0.57, against the concept forearm's (127, 88, 48), hue 30, S 0.62, V 0.50, so slightly brighter, yellower and less saturated, while the glow-close pauldron is V 0.43. The grille core is yellower than the sheet's (median hue 41 to 43 against 33) and lacks the sheet's orange-red rim and spill onto the walnut. The dark olive knuckle blocks break the brass colour within the fist.

At 2.6 m the head, the eyes and the six-slot grille give a strong focal point and the brass-and-walnut brute reads at once. The fists are still the nearest and largest shapes in the seated view, and they read as a cupped hand of pegs in idle and as a row of pale teeth in attack, not as crushing fists, which works against the crush tell. The hit shot shows no core flare (glow median (243, 177, 78) against idle (242, 173, 79)), so hit relies on pose; the frozen tint gap is a known evidence gap and is not counted.

topFixes: Rebuild the fists as one closed brass mass wider than the gauntlet: fingers fused into flat-faced plates with only shallow creases (no gunmetal gaps), a heavy thumb plate folded over the index and middle fingers instead of the tube hook, and the fist material switched to the same brass the forearm uses so the knuckles stop reading as wooden dowels or pale teeth. This moves all five criteria, because the fists are the nearest shapes in the seated view.

Fix the brass tileable on flat faces: the knuckle fronts, gauntlet end caps and grille bars show a wood-like grain and turn pale cream at grazing angles, and the head still shows the circular swirl. Use a factor-only or a much finer brushed brass on small flat faces and remove the swirl from the head, then re-measure the fist and forearm brass in the same shot.

Change the large shapes the head fix left behind: replace the side-on drum pauldrons with curved plates that hug the barrel and cap the shoulder, angle the forearms forward so the fists sit ahead of the knees with a slight forward hunch, and bulk the legs with brass armour and a round knee joint carrying an emerald visible from the front.
independentScore.method: Re-score of the uncommitted golem pass-2 build on HEAD 4aeecbd by a separate reviewer agent that did not build the model. Each point of the previous 68 review was re-checked against the new images rather than carried forward. Silhouette and proportions were judged from the EEVEE orthographic front, side and back panels of bellows-golem.fidelity-compare.jpg (cropped and enlarged 2x with Pillow), because they match the sheet's angles and scale. Material and colour were weighted on the six engine shots (three.js, the seated player at 2.6 m, with the runtime D11 glow), because the game is seen through that renderer, the glow ramp is runtime-only (so the EEVEE grilles read pale) and the dark EEVEE backdrop mirrors in the polished brass and skews its value. Colour is the median sRGB of body pixels in hand-placed boxes checked by overlay, never floor: walnut on strap-free barrel panels, pleats between the front straps, brass on the forearm gauntlet and pauldron with a hue-ratio mask, knuckles on the right fist, glow by a max-channel-over-180 mask, and glow slots counted as glow runs along the grille's centre line in glow-close and on the concept. Claims checked: clenched fists (partly: knuckle row present, but separate blocks over a gunmetal core with a tube thumb, and the knuckles read as wood), taller head with a face plate (yes; plate barely raised, swirl remains), domed pauldron caps (present, still read as drums), darker pleats (yes, value matches), tapered bellows (yes), back strap arc (yes, shallower than the sheet), six-slot grille with a hot centre (yes, measured), brass normal 0.06 (the swirl is still visible on the head). The frozen shot's missing rime tint and the missing flame plume were not counted. Rubric: silhouette and proportions 30, signature features 25, surface detail and material read 20, colour and value 15, readability at play distance 10; bar 80.
